content.text:
I fixed the crash: Babel no longer fails when the input source map you pass in has no `sourcesContent` field.

**Cause:** `sourcesContent` is optional in source maps, and the map from your bundler doesn't include it. In 7.21.0, `@babel/generator` reads `this._inputMap.sourcesContent[i]` for every input source without checking that the array exists. With no array, that read throws `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')`.

**Fix:** one line in `packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts`:

```ts
this._inputMap.sourcesContent?.[i] || null,
```

If the original source text isn't there, Babel now records `null` for it instead of crashing.

**Checks:** I rebuilt the package and ran a throwaway test using an input map with no `sourcesContent`. It now produces a valid map with `sourcesContent: [ null ]` instead of throwing; I deleted the test afterwards. The existing `@babel/generator` and `@babel/core` source-map tests all pass. I haven't added a permanent regression test.
